# Zutok Softwares: full reference

> Zutok Softwares makes Zutok CRM, an all-in-one CRM built for Indian businesses and priced in rupees. Three products plug into it: ZChat, a WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and Telegram inbox with an AI sales agent; ZShop, which sends WhatsApp order updates, COD confirmations and abandoned-cart reminders for Shopify, WooCommerce and in-house stores; and Zloya, which runs loyalty points, VIP tiers, memberships and retention journeys for restaurants, cafés, salons and stores. Zutok CRM costs ₹1,299 per user per month (₹999 per user with 5 or more users) and ZChat plans start at ₹2,000/month, billed monthly and excluding 18% GST, and ZShop and Zloya come free with ZChat Growth and Scale.

This file is generated from the same content as https://www.zutok.in/ and lists only what the site says. All prices are in Indian Rupees (INR) and exclude 18% GST. The short index is at https://www.zutok.in/llms.txt.

## Company

URL: https://www.zutok.in/about/

- Website: https://www.zutok.in/
- Company: Zutok Softwares, also called Zutok. Its products are always named with the brand: Zutok CRM, Zutok ZChat, Zutok ZShop, Zutok Zloya.
- Market: businesses in India that sell on WhatsApp, Instagram and at the counter.
- Prices: in Indian Rupees (INR), excluding 18% GST. Zutok ZChat is sold as plans and Zutok CRM is priced per user (one CRM license is one user), billed monthly or yearly. ZShop and Zloya are included free with ZChat Growth and Scale. They aren't sold separately. Zutok CRM costs ₹1,299 per user per month, ₹1,199 per user with 3 users and ₹999 per user with 5 or more users; billed yearly it's 20% less (₹1,039, ₹959 and ₹799 per user per month). ZChat yearly prices are ₹19,200 for Starter, ₹47,988 for Growth and ₹95,988 for Scale. No setup fee.
- WhatsApp: ZChat connects to the official WhatsApp Business Platform. Meta's per-message charges for WhatsApp template messages are billed separately at Meta's published rates.
- Contact: admin@zutok.in. Book a demo at https://www.zutok.in/#demo. Customers log in at https://crm.zutok.in/.

### How onboarding works

1. **Book a demo**: We look at how you sell today and show you the parts of Zutok that fit.
2. **We set it up with you**: Channels, store, catalogue, tiers and team, configured together on a call.
3. **Watch it run**: Chats get answered, orders confirmed and guests come back, all in one CRM.

### Common questions

**What is Zutok?**
Zutok Softwares makes Zutok CRM, an all-in-one CRM built for Indian businesses and priced in rupees. Three products plug into it: ZChat, a WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and Telegram inbox with an AI sales agent; ZShop, which sends WhatsApp order updates, COD confirmations and abandoned-cart reminders for Shopify, WooCommerce and in-house stores; and Zloya, which runs loyalty points, VIP tiers, memberships and retention journeys for restaurants, cafés, salons and stores. Zutok CRM costs ₹1,299 per user per month (₹999 per user with 5 or more users) and ZChat plans start at ₹2,000/month, billed monthly and excluding 18% GST, and ZShop and Zloya come free with ZChat Growth and Scale.

**Can Zutok automate WhatsApp and Instagram?**
Yes. ZChat's AI sales agent answers product and price questions from your catalogue on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and Telegram. On WhatsApp, ZChat also sends broadcasts on Meta-approved templates, and ZShop confirms COD orders, sends order updates and reminds abandoned carts. On Instagram and Facebook, ZChat replies to comments on your posts and reels and sends a private DM to everyone who comments.

**Can I buy just one product?**
Yes. Zutok CRM (priced per user) and ZChat (sold as plans) are sold separately, and every ZChat plan includes CRM licenses. ZShop and Zloya aren't sold on their own: they're included free with ZChat Growth (₹5,000/month, or ₹3,999/month billed yearly) and Scale (₹10,000/month, or ₹7,499/month billed yearly), excluding 18% GST.

**What's in each ZChat plan?**
ZChat Starter (₹2,000/month, or ₹19,200/year) includes 500 contacts, 1 channel and 1 CRM license. ZChat Growth (₹5,000/month, or ₹47,988/year) includes 1,500 contacts, 2 channels and 2 CRM licenses, with ZShop and Zloya free. ZChat Scale (₹10,000/month, or ₹95,988/year) includes unlimited contacts, 4 channels and 4 CRM licenses, with ZShop and Zloya free. Prices exclude 18% GST.

**Do I pay per user?**
Yes, for Zutok CRM: it's priced per user, and one CRM license is one user. Zutok CRM costs ₹1,299 per user per month, ₹1,199 per user with 3 users and ₹999 per user with 5 or more users; billed yearly it's 20% less (₹1,039, ₹959 and ₹799 per user per month). ZChat plans have a flat monthly price instead, and include 500, 1,500 or unlimited contacts, 1, 2 or 4 channels and 1, 2 or 4 CRM licenses. Prices exclude 18% GST.

**How does the ZChat AI know my prices?**
You add each product with your own columns and rows, like size, paper, quantity, price and order link. The AI asks the customer each choice and quotes only from the row that matches, so it never makes up a price.

**Is my data safe, and who owns it?**
Your data belongs to you. It is stored on secure servers with regular database backups, and you can export customers, leads and invoices to CSV or PDF whenever you like.

**Do you help with WhatsApp Business API approval?**
Yes. We guide you through connecting your number to the official WhatsApp Business Platform and getting your message templates approved by Meta.

**Do invoices support GST?**
Yes. Proposals, estimates, invoices and credit notes are all in rupees with tax fields, and you can export them in bulk as PDF.

**Is there a setup fee or lock-in?**
There is no setup fee. Monthly plans can be cancelled at the end of any month. Billed yearly, Zutok CRM costs 20% less, and yearly ZChat plans cost ₹19,200 for Starter, ₹47,988 for Growth or ₹95,988 for Scale a year.

## Products

### Zutok CRM

URL: https://www.zutok.in/products/crm/

CRM software for small businesses in India: leads, customers, proposals, GST invoices, projects, HRM, payroll and inventory in one CRM. Chats from ZChat, orders from ZShop and guests from Zloya land in the same place.

#### Features

- **Leads & pipeline**: Leads from chats, Meta Lead Ads, IndiaMART and estimate requests move from Enquiry to Follow-up, Hot and Customer.
- **Customers & contracts**: Every customer with their contacts, invoices, projects and tickets on one profile, plus contracts that remind you before renewal.
- **Proposals & estimates**: Send proposals and estimates, collect estimate requests from your website and turn accepted ones into invoices.
- **GST invoices & payments**: Invoices in rupees with tax fields, recurring invoices, payments, credit notes and bulk PDF export for your accountant.
- **Projects & tasks**: Milestones, tasks, timesheets and meeting notes, all linked to the customer they belong to.
- **HRM & payroll**: Staff records, contracts, insurance and salary, with alerts before a contract expires.
- **Attendance & leave**: Shift planner, attendance and leave requests without the spreadsheets.
- **Inventory & warehouse**: Stock in, stock out, losses and adjustments, with a full history for every warehouse.
- **Real estate suite**: Properties, owners, agents, brokers, buy and rent requests, and tenants in one place.
- **Subscriptions & expenses**: Recurring billing, expense tracking and a clear expenses vs income view.
- **Support & knowledge base**: Tickets, a knowledge base and surveys that keep customers happy after the sale.
- **Automation & reports**: Custom email and SMS templates, scheduled jobs, company goals and reports on sales, leads and timesheets.

#### Modules

- **Leads & Pipeline**: Capture leads from chats, Meta Lead Ads and imports, then move them from enquiry to paying customer. (Enquiry → Follow-up → Hot → Customer; Meta Lead Ads & IndiaMART; Field mapping)
- **Sales & GST Invoicing**: Proposals, estimates, invoices, payments and credit notes, all in rupees. (Proposals & estimates; Recurring invoices; Payments & credit notes)
- **Projects & Tasks**: Plan projects, assign tasks, log time and keep meeting notes next to the client. (Projects & milestones; Tasks & timesheets; Meeting notes)
- **HRM & Payroll**: Staff records, contracts, insurance and salary, with alerts before contracts expire. (Staff & contracts; Insurance; Salary & payroll)
- **Attendance & Leave**: Shifts, shift tables, attendance and leave requests without the spreadsheets. (Shift planner; Leave requests; Attendance reports)
- **Inventory & Warehouse**: Stock in, stock out, losses and adjustments, with a full warehouse history. (Stock import & export; Loss & adjustment; Warehouse reports)
- **Real Estate Suite**: Properties, owners, agents, brokers, buy and rental requests, and tenants. (Properties & approvals; Buy & rent requests; Tenants & reports)
- **Subscriptions & Expenses**: Recurring billing, expense tracking and an expenses vs income view. (Subscriptions; Expenses; Expenses vs income)
- **Support & Knowledge Base**: Tickets, a knowledge base and surveys to keep customers happy after the sale. (Support tickets; Knowledge base; Surveys)
- **Automation & Messaging**: Automation manager, scheduled jobs and custom email and SMS templates. (Automation manager; Custom email / SMS; Scheduled jobs)
- **Reports & Goals**: Sales, orders, quantities, leads and timesheet reports, plus company goals. (Sales & order reports; Lead reports; Goals tracking)
- **Customers & Contracts**: Customer profiles with contacts and full history, plus contracts that remind you before renewal. (Customers & contacts; Contract renewals; Bulk PDF & CSV export)

#### Getting started

1. **Bring your data in**: Import customers, leads and items from Excel or your old CRM. We help you during onboarding.
2. **Set up your team**: Add staff with roles and permissions, your lead stages, tax rates and invoice format.
3. **Run the whole business**: Leads, invoices, projects, payroll and stock in one place, with ZChat, ZShop or Zloya plugged in when you need them.

#### In numbers

- 30+ modules, from leads to payroll
- 4 lead stages, enquiry to customer
- 3 products that plug in: ZChat, ZShop, Zloya

#### Prices

Zutok CRM is priced per user: one CRM license is one user. Zutok CRM costs ₹1,299 per user per month, ₹1,199 per user with 3 users and ₹999 per user with 5 or more users; billed yearly it's 20% less (₹1,039, ₹959 and ₹799 per user per month), excl. 18% GST. Every price is listed under Pricing below.

#### FAQ

**Can I bring in my existing data?**
Yes. Import customers, leads and items from Excel or CSV, or from your old CRM. We help with the import during onboarding.

**Does invoicing support GST?**
Yes. Proposals, estimates, invoices and credit notes are in rupees with tax fields, and you can export them in bulk as PDF.

**Can I control what each staff member sees?**
Yes. Each staff member gets a role with its own permissions, so sales, accounts and HR only see what they need.

**Do I need ZChat, ZShop or Zloya to use the CRM?**
No. Zutok CRM works on its own. When you add a product, its chats, orders or guests land in the same CRM.

**How much does Zutok CRM cost?**
Zutok CRM is priced per user: one CRM license is one user. Zutok CRM costs ₹1,299 per user per month, ₹1,199 per user with 3 users and ₹999 per user with 5 or more users; billed yearly it's 20% less (₹1,039, ₹959 and ₹799 per user per month). That comes to ₹12,468, ₹11,508 and ₹9,588 per user per year. Prices exclude 18% GST.

**Are all modules included whatever the number of users?**
Yes. Zutok CRM is priced per user, and leads, proposals and GST invoices, projects, HRM, inventory, the Real Estate suite, support tickets, automation, reports and custom fields are all part of it.

**Can I try Zutok before I buy?**
Book a free 30-minute demo and we'll show you Zutok using your own products, channels and outlets. There is no setup fee, and monthly plans can be cancelled at the end of any month.

**Is Zutok CRM cloud-based?**
Yes. It's web-based: your team logs in at crm.zutok.in from a browser, with nothing to install.

**Does Zutok CRM include a help desk for support tickets?**
Yes. The Support & Knowledge Base module keeps support tickets on each customer's profile, next to their contacts, invoices and projects, so follow-up requests stay with the rest of that customer's history. The same module also has a knowledge base and surveys.

**What can Zutok CRM automate?**
An automation manager, scheduled jobs and custom email and SMS templates. Built-in reminders also cover lead follow-ups, contract renewals, staff contracts that are about to expire and overdue invoices.

**Does Zutok CRM include reports and goals?**
Yes: reports on sales, orders, quantities, leads and timesheets, plus company goals tracking.

**Can I add my own fields?**
Yes. Zutok CRM has custom fields for every module.

### Zutok ZChat

URL: https://www.zutok.in/products/zchat/

Omnichannel inbox + AI agent. WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and Telegram land in one shared inbox. An AI agent answers in seconds, your team takes over when it matters, and every chat becomes a lead in your CRM.

#### Features

- **One unified inbox**: WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and Telegram in one place, with All, Mine and Unassigned views and Open, Pending and Resolved status.
- **AI sales agent**: Add your products once. On WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger or Telegram, the agent asks each choice as a numbered list and replies with the price, order link and files from the one row that matches.
- **Your own columns & rows**: Size, colour, paper, delivery time, brochure: any column, any number. Set each one as a choice, information, quantity, price, link or file.
- **Business knowledge**: Timings, address, delivery areas, payment and return policy. The AI answers only from the facts you give it and never guesses.
- **Choose your AI**: Run the agent on OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Vertex AI or your own model, with your own temperature and reply length.
- **Auto-assign backlog**: Spread new and waiting chats across your team automatically so nothing sits unanswered.
- **WhatsApp broadcasting**: Send Meta-approved templates to leads, contacts or a custom audience, and see sent, delivered and read numbers as they come in.
- **Template studio**: Create and sync Text, Image, PDF, Video and Button templates for Marketing, Utility and Authentication, and track their approval status.
- **Comment → DM automation**: Auto-reply to comments on Instagram and Facebook posts and reels, and send a private DM to everyone who comments.
- **Labels & quick replies**: Tag conversations and answer the questions you get every day with saved replies.
- **Contacts → CRM leads**: Every new chat creates a lead in Zutok CRM with its source, so sales can follow it up from one place.
- **Team reports**: Conversations, resolution rate, average resolution time, load per channel and per agent.

#### Getting started

1. **Connect channels**: Link WhatsApp Business, Instagram, Messenger and Telegram in a few clicks.
2. **Add your catalogue**: Products, your own columns and rows, plus your business facts. Or import them from a sheet.
3. **Sell on autopilot**: The AI asks, quotes and sends the order link, and hands over to your team when needed.

#### In numbers

- 4 messaging apps in one inbox
- 24/7 AI replies, day or night
- 5 template formats: text, image, PDF, video, buttons

#### Plans

From ₹2,000/month, or ₹1,599/month billed yearly, excl. 18% GST. Every plan is listed under Pricing below.

#### FAQ

**Does ZChat need the WhatsApp Business API?**
Yes. ZChat connects to the official WhatsApp Business Platform, and we help you set up and verify your number during onboarding. The [WhatsApp Business API](https://www.zutok.in/solutions/whatsapp-business-api/) page covers setup and Meta's charges.

**Are Meta's WhatsApp charges included?**
No. Meta's per-message charges for template messages are billed separately at its published rates. Your ZChat plan covers the Zutok software.

**How does the AI know my prices?**
You add each product with your own columns and rows, like paper, size, quantity, price and order link. The AI only quotes from the row that matches the customer's choices, so it never makes up a price.

**Can the AI agent hand a chat to my team?**
Yes. Turn on handoff and the agent passes the conversation to a person whenever a customer asks for one or the question falls outside its instructions.

**Does the AI agent work on Instagram, Messenger and Telegram too?**
Yes. The same AI agent answers on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and Telegram, all from one shared inbox, and quotes only from the catalogue and business facts you add.

**Can ZChat be my Telegram bot for business?**
Yes. The same AI agent that answers WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger also replies on Telegram: it asks each choice as a numbered list, quotes only from the catalogue row that matches, answers other questions only from your business facts and hands the chat to your team when needed. Telegram chats sit in the same shared inbox, and every new chat becomes a CRM lead with its source.

**How much does ZChat cost?**
ZChat Starter costs ₹2,000/month for 500 contacts, 1 channel and 1 CRM license; Growth ₹5,000/month for 1,500 contacts, 2 channels and 2 CRM licenses; and Scale ₹10,000/month for unlimited contacts, 4 channels and 4 CRM licenses. Prices are billed monthly and exclude 18% GST. Billed yearly, ZChat Starter costs ₹19,200 a year (shown as ₹1,599 a month), Growth ₹47,988 a year (shown as ₹3,999 a month) and Scale ₹95,988 a year (shown as ₹7,499 a month). ZShop and Zloya are included free with ZChat Growth and Scale.

### Zutok ZShop

URL: https://www.zutok.in/products/zshop/

Shopify & WooCommerce WhatsApp integration. Connect Shopify, WooCommerce or your in-house counter. ZShop brings every order into the CRM, confirms cash-on-delivery on WhatsApp, recovers abandoned carts and keeps buyers updated until the parcel arrives.

#### Features

- **Connect any store**: Shopify through a custom app, WooCommerce or any platform with an API, or an in-house shop whose items live in the CRM. Every feature works the same on all three.
- **WhatsApp order updates**: Order placed, packed, shipped and delivered, sent from your ZChat number. When a buyer replies, it lands in the same inbox.
- **COD confirmation**: Ask cash-on-delivery buyers to confirm on WhatsApp, remind them automatically and tag confirmed orders. Nothing is cancelled unless you choose to.
- **Abandoned-cart recovery**: Three reminders, after one hour, one day and three days, with a discount you set at each step. The first reminder carries none.
- **Courier tracking**: Checks courier status for out-for-delivery, delivered and failed attempts, and learns your real delivery times, like “usually 3–5 days”.
- **Quiet hours & limits**: Promotional messages respect quiet hours and a daily limit. Order updates always go out when they happen.
- **Buyers → CRM**: Every customer becomes a CRM lead, matched on phone number only, so two people with the same name are never mixed up.
- **One do-not-contact list**: When someone says “stop contacting me”, it applies on every channel, shared with ZChat and ZCall.
- **Automations & templates**: Discounts, carts, messages and automations in one place, with Meta template mapping for every numbered blank.

#### Getting started

1. **Connect your store**: Shopify, WooCommerce, a custom site, or an in-house counter. Webhooks register themselves.
2. **Approve your templates**: Map your Meta templates once. We show you which fields fill each blank.
3. **Let orders run themselves**: COD confirmations, cart reminders and delivery updates go out automatically.

#### In numbers

- 32 Shopify webhook topics synced
- 3 abandoned-cart reminders
- 3 store types: Shopify, API, in-house

#### Plans

Zutok ZShop isn't sold separately: it's included free with ZChat Growth (₹5,000/month, or ₹3,999/month billed yearly) and Scale (₹10,000/month, or ₹7,499/month billed yearly), excl. 18% GST. See Zutok ZChat under Pricing below.

#### FAQ

**Will ZShop cancel orders when a COD buyer doesn't reply?**
Not by default. Buyers who don't confirm are tagged, and your team decides. You can switch on auto-cancel if you want it.

**Why does WhatsApp need approved templates?**
WhatsApp only allows free-form messages within 24 hours of the customer's last message. Most order updates fall outside that window, so they are sent as approved templates.

**I don't have a website. Can I still use ZShop?**
Yes. Choose an in-house shop, keep your items in the CRM and take orders at the counter. Every automation still works.

**Do I need a developer to connect Shopify or WooCommerce?**
Shopify connects through a custom app whose webhooks register themselves, and WooCommerce or any platform with an API connects too. You map your Meta templates once, and Zutok sets the store up with you on the onboarding call.

**Which number do the messages come from, and where do replies go?**
Your ZChat number, on the official WhatsApp Business Platform. Buyer replies land in the same ZChat inbox. That's why ZShop comes with ZChat: it's included free with ZChat Growth and Scale.

**What does ZShop cost?**
Zutok ZShop isn't sold on its own: it's included free with ZChat Growth (₹5,000/month, or ₹3,999/month billed yearly) and Scale (₹10,000/month, or ₹7,499/month billed yearly), excluding 18% GST. Meta's charges are billed separately, and there is no setup fee.

**Is this the same as a WhatsApp chat button?**
No. A chat button only opens a chat. ZShop sends messages triggered by your store's own events, such as new orders, COD orders, abandoned carts and courier status, from your ZChat number.

### Zutok Zloya

URL: https://www.zutok.in/products/zloya/

Loyalty program software for restaurants, cafés, salons and stores. Award points at the counter, sell memberships, run automated win-back journeys and collect guest feedback and Google reviews.

#### Features

- **POS quick counter**: Cashiers look up a guest by mobile number, enter the bill and award points in seconds. Redemptions are protected by OTP.
- **VIP tiers**: Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum, with point multipliers from 1× to 2× and perks unlocked by spend and visits.
- **Memberships & wallets**: Sell yearly perk bundles or prepaid wallets, like pay ₹5,000 and get ₹6,000 in credit, with a staff sales leaderboard.
- **Automated journeys**: Welcome, birthday, 30-day win-back, points-expiry and feedback messages go out on their own, each with a coupon locked to the guest's phone number.
- **Smart QR codes**: QR codes on table standees, Swiggy and Zomato delivery boxes and partner stores collect guests' phone numbers. Track scans, sign-ups and opt-in rate for each code.
- **Reputation booster**: Guests rate food, service, ambience and cleanliness, and low ratings alert a manager, who can follow up with that guest. Separately, the booster points guests to your Google review page.
- **Smart segments**: New, Regulars, Potential VIPs, Slipping (30 days), Lost (60+ days) and upcoming birthdays, updated automatically.
- **Retention analytics**: Repeat guest rate, loyalty-tracked sales and prepaid membership revenue on one dashboard.
- **Zloya Pass**: A digital loyalty pass on the guest's phone: their VIP tier, points balance, progress to the next tier, unlocked perks and coupons to show at the counter.
- **Birthdays & anniversaries**: Send a personal greeting with a gift and double points that make guests want to come back.

#### Getting started

1. **Place QR & open the counter**: Print standees, stick QR on delivery packs and log in at the POS counter.
2. **Guests earn and join**: Every bill earns points, tiers unlock perks, memberships lock in future visits.
3. **Journeys bring them back**: Birthday gifts, win-back vouchers and expiry nudges run on autopilot.

#### In numbers

- 4 VIP tiers, 1× to 2× points
- 5 ready-made retention journeys
- 4 feedback dimensions per visit

#### Plans

Zutok Zloya isn't sold separately: it's included free with ZChat Growth (₹5,000/month, or ₹3,999/month billed yearly) and Scale (₹10,000/month, or ₹7,499/month billed yearly), excl. 18% GST. See Zutok ZChat under Pricing below.

#### FAQ

**Does Zloya work without a POS integration?**
Yes. The POS quick counter runs in any browser next to your current billing, so the cashier enters the bill amount and Zloya handles the rest. If you want your POS connected, ask about API / POS integration during your demo.

**How do Zloya loyalty points work?**
The cashier enters the bill amount at the POS quick counter, and points are added at the guest's tier multiplier, from 1× on Bronze to 2× on Platinum. The balance sits on the guest's record. Points can expire, and the points-expiry journey reminds guests to use them first.

**Do I have to replace my billing software?**
No. Zloya's POS quick counter runs in any browser next to the billing you already use.

**Do guests get a digital loyalty card?**
Yes. Guests get a Zloya Pass, a digital loyalty pass on their phone that shows your business name, their VIP tier and points balance, how far they are from the next tier, the perks they've unlocked and coupons to show at the counter.

**How many VIP tiers are there?**
Four: Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum, with point multipliers from 1× to 2× and perks unlocked by spend and visits.

**How are redemptions protected from misuse?**
Every redemption needs a one-time password sent to the guest's phone, and every coupon is locked to one phone number.

**Can I run it across multiple outlets?**
Yes. Zloya shares the same guest profile across every outlet, so a regular is recognised at each branch.

**What does Zloya cost?**
Zutok Zloya isn't sold on its own: it's included free with ZChat Growth (₹5,000/month, or ₹3,999/month billed yearly) and Scale (₹10,000/month, or ₹7,499/month billed yearly), excluding 18% GST. There is no setup fee.

### Billing questions

**How much does Zutok cost?**
Zutok ZChat starts at ₹2,000/month, or ₹1,599/month billed yearly (₹19,200 a year). Zutok CRM costs ₹1,299 per user per month, ₹1,199 per user with 3 users and ₹999 per user with 5 or more users; billed yearly it's 20% less (₹1,039, ₹959 and ₹799 per user per month). Prices exclude 18% GST, and there is no setup fee.

**What's in each ZChat plan?**
ZChat Starter (₹2,000/month, or ₹19,200/year) includes 500 contacts, 1 channel and 1 CRM license. ZChat Growth (₹5,000/month, or ₹47,988/year) includes 1,500 contacts, 2 channels and 2 CRM licenses, with ZShop and Zloya free. ZChat Scale (₹10,000/month, or ₹95,988/year) includes unlimited contacts, 4 channels and 4 CRM licenses, with ZShop and Zloya free. Prices exclude 18% GST.

**Can I buy ZShop or Zloya on their own?**
No. Zutok ZShop and Zutok Zloya aren't sold separately: they're included free with ZChat Growth (₹5,000/month, or ₹3,999/month billed yearly) and Scale (₹10,000/month, or ₹7,499/month billed yearly), excluding 18% GST.

**Are prices inclusive of GST?**
No. All prices are in Indian Rupees and exclude 18% GST, which is added to your invoice.

**How does yearly billing work?**
Zutok CRM's yearly prices are 20% less than monthly, per user: ₹1,039 per user per month (₹12,468 a year) for 1 user, ₹959 per user per month (₹11,508 a year) with 3 users and ₹799 per user per month (₹9,588 a year) with 5 or more users. ZChat's yearly prices are fixed: Starter ₹19,200 a year (shown as ₹1,599/month), Growth ₹47,988 (₹3,999/month) and Scale ₹95,988 (₹7,499/month).

**What does WhatsApp messaging cost on top?**
Meta charges per template message at its published rates for India, billed separately from your Zutok plan and at cost. Meta's [WhatsApp pricing page](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/pricing/) lists the current rates and the messages it doesn't charge for.

**Is there a setup fee?**
No. There is no setup fee on any plan.

**Can I cancel anytime?**
Monthly plans can be cancelled at the end of any month.

**Can I try Zutok first?**
Yes. Book a free 30-minute demo and we'll show you Zutok using your own products, channels and outlets, then help you choose the right plan.

**Do I pay per user?**
Yes, for Zutok CRM: it's priced per user, and one CRM license is one user. Zutok CRM costs ₹1,299 per user per month, ₹1,199 per user with 3 users and ₹999 per user with 5 or more users; billed yearly it's 20% less (₹1,039, ₹959 and ₹799 per user per month). ZChat plans have a flat monthly price instead, and include 500, 1,500 or unlimited contacts, 1, 2 or 4 channels and 1, 2 or 4 CRM licenses. Prices exclude 18% GST.

**Can I switch ZChat plans later?**
Yes. You can upgrade at any time and the difference is prorated. You can downgrade at the end of your billing period.

**Do you offer discounts for NGOs, startups or multiple outlets?**
Yes. Ask during your demo. We have special pricing for non-profits, early-stage startups and chains with 10+ outlets.

Order updates do, because buyers want them as soon as they happen. ZShop's promotional messages, like cart reminders, wait for your quiet hours to end, and the AI agent replies whenever a customer writes to you.

No. It quotes only the price in the catalogue row that matches the customer's choices. With handoff on, a customer who asks for a person, or asks something outside the agent's instructions, goes to your team with the whole history.

Only from the business knowledge you give it: timings, address, delivery areas, and payment and return policy. It doesn't guess, and anything outside its instructions can go to your team.

### WhatsApp message templates

URL: https://www.zutok.in/solutions/whatsapp-message-templates/

Product: Zutok ZChat

A WhatsApp template message is written in advance and approved by Meta, and you need one whenever you message a customer more than 24 hours after their last message. In Zutok ZChat's template studio, Indian businesses create or sync Text, Image, PDF, Video and Button templates, choose Marketing, Utility or Authentication, and track approval. ZChat plans start at ₹2,000/month billed monthly (₹19,200/year, or ₹1,599/month billed yearly), excl. 18% GST.

The template studio and broadcasts are part of Zutok ZChat, with plans from ₹2,000/month billed monthly (₹19,200/year, or ₹1,599/month billed yearly), excl. 18% GST. Meta may also charge for each template message you send, billed separately at Meta's published rates for India and at cost; its [pricing page](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/pricing/) has the current rates.

#### FAQ

**What's the difference between a session message and a template message?**
A session (free-form) message is any reply sent within 24 hours of the customer's last message. A template message is written in advance and approved by Meta, and it's the only kind you can send after those 24 hours.

**Do WhatsApp templates need Meta's approval?**
Yes. Each template is submitted to Meta under a category and can be sent once it's approved. ZChat shows the approval status of every template, and Zutok guides you through getting templates approved. Approval itself is Meta's decision.

**Can I use templates I've already made in Meta?**
Yes. Templates you've already made in Meta sync into ZChat's template studio in one click, so you can use them in broadcasts without rebuilding them.

**What happens when a customer replies to a template?**
The reply lands in ZChat's shared inbox. Because the 24 hours count from the customer's last message, your team or the AI sales agent can then answer free-form, and a new chat becomes a lead in Zutok CRM with its source.

**How do order details get into an order-update template?**
Through ZShop's template mapping. You map your Meta-approved templates once, and ZShop shows which order or cart fields fill each numbered blank, then fills them in for every COD confirmation, order update and cart reminder.

**Is it free to send WhatsApp template messages?**
Not always. Meta charges per template message by category (Marketing, Utility or Authentication) at its published rates for India, billed separately from your Zutok plan and at cost. Meta's [pricing page](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/pricing/) also says utility templates sent while the customer service window is open, the 24 hours after the customer's last message, are free. The template studio itself is part of Zutok ZChat, from ₹2,000/month.

### WhatsApp COD confirmation

#### FAQ

**What happens if a COD buyer doesn't reply? Is the order cancelled?**
Not by default. Buyers who don't confirm are tagged, and your team decides. You can switch on auto-cancel if you want it.

**Can WhatsApp confirmation stop all fake COD orders?**
No. It gives you a signal before you commit stock and courier charges: confirmed orders go out as normal, and unanswered ones wait for your team to check. No tool can guarantee that every COD buyer accepts the parcel.

**What goes in the confirmation message?**
Your own Meta-approved template, mapped once during setup. ZShop shows which order fields fill each numbered blank, and buttons like ✅ Confirm and ❌ Cancel are one way to let the buyer answer.

**Can I confirm COD orders without a website?**
Yes. Choose an in-house shop, keep your items in the CRM and take orders at the counter. COD confirmation works the same way as it does for Shopify and WooCommerce.

**When does the reminder go out?**
By default, 4 hours after the first message. ZShop stops asking after 24 hours.

**Do I need ZChat as well as ZShop?**
Yes. ZShop sends WhatsApp messages from your ZChat number, and it comes free with ZChat Growth and Scale, so one ZChat plan covers both. Meta's per-message charges for template messages are billed separately.

**When are the abandoned cart reminders sent?**
After one hour, one day and three days. The first reminder carries no discount, and you set the discount on the second and third.

**What happens if a shopper asks to stop receiving messages?**
It applies everywhere. When someone says “stop contacting me”, ZShop's single do-not-contact list, shared with ZChat, covers every channel.

**Does cart recovery work with WooCommerce and in-house stores?**
Yes. Every ZShop feature works the same on Shopify, WooCommerce (or any platform with an API) and in-house shops.

**Can I change the discounts?**
Yes. You set the discount on the second and third reminders, for example 5% and 10%. The first reminder carries no discount.

**Do cart reminders need the WhatsApp Business API?**
Yes. Reminders go out from your ZChat number on the official WhatsApp Business Platform, using Meta-approved templates. The [WhatsApp Business API](https://www.zutok.in/solutions/whatsapp-business-api/) page covers setup and Meta's charges.

**What happens when a shopper replies to a reminder?**
The reply lands in your ZChat inbox, where your team can answer it.

### WhatsApp order updates & courier tracking

URL: https://www.zutok.in/solutions/whatsapp-order-updates-courier-tracking/

Product: Zutok ZShop

Zutok ZShop sends buyers WhatsApp updates when an order is placed, packed, shipped and delivered, from your ZChat number. Its courier tracking checks status for out-for-delivery, delivered and failed attempts, and learns your real delivery times, like “usually 3–5 days”. ZShop is included free with ZChat Growth (₹5,000/month, or ₹3,999/month billed yearly) and Scale (₹10,000/month, or ₹7,499/month billed yearly), excl. 18% GST.

WhatsApp order updates, courier tracking and delivery estimates are part of [Zutok ZShop](https://www.zutok.in/products/zshop/), which isn't sold on its own: it's included free with ZChat Growth (₹5,000/month, or ₹3,999/month billed yearly) and Scale (₹10,000/month, or ₹7,499/month billed yearly), excl. 18% GST. ZShop sends through ZChat, and Meta's charges are separate.

#### FAQ

**Can customers get an out-for-delivery message on WhatsApp?**
Yes, with ZShop's courier tracking. It checks courier status every few hours and covers out-for-delivery, delivered and failed attempts.

**What happens when a buyer replies to an order update?**
The reply lands in the same ZChat inbox as your other chats, so your team can answer it there.

**Are order updates sent at night?**
Yes. Order updates always go out when they happen, even at 11 pm. Only promotional messages wait for quiet hours to end.

**Can I test the messages before buyers see them?**
Yes. Test messages only go to your own test number.

**Can I add my own tracking link or a Track button?**
Yes. The shipped update carries the tracking link you set, never a guessed one, and your approved template can include a button.

**What happens on a failed delivery attempt?**
ZShop's courier tracking checks for failed attempts as well as out-for-delivery and delivered, so the buyer's updates follow what actually happened to the parcel. If the buyer replies, the reply lands in your ZChat inbox for your team.

**Do updates work for WooCommerce and counter orders?**
Yes. WooCommerce, any platform with an API and in-house shops get the same updates as Shopify. With no website, keep your items in the CRM and take orders at the counter in ZShop's in-house shop.

### Memberships & prepaid wallets

URL: https://www.zutok.in/solutions/restaurant-membership-prepaid-wallet/

Product: Zutok Zloya

Zutok Zloya lets restaurants, cafés and stores sell memberships at the counter: yearly perk bundles, or prepaid wallets like pay ₹5,000 and get ₹6,000 in credit. Every redemption needs a one-time password sent to the guest's phone, and a live leaderboard shows which staff sell the most. Zloya is included free with ZChat Growth (₹5,000/month, or ₹3,999/month billed yearly) and Scale (₹10,000/month, or ₹7,499/month billed yearly), excl. 18% GST.

#### FAQ

**How are membership and wallet redemptions protected from misuse?**
Every redemption needs a one-time password sent to the guest's phone, and every coupon is locked to one phone number.

**Is there an expiry date on the wallet balance?**
Wallet credit comes with a validity period. In the “Prepaid Wallet 5K” example, the ₹6,000 of credit is valid for 180 days.

**How do I track which staff sell memberships?**
On Zloya's live staff sales leaderboard, which ranks membership sales by staff member. Zloya comes free with ZChat Growth and Scale.

**Do I need a POS integration to sell memberships?**
No. The POS quick counter runs in any browser, so the cashier enters the bill amount and Zloya handles the rest. If you want your POS connected, ask about API / POS integration during your demo.

**Is a member recognised at every outlet?**
Yes. The guest profile is shared across every outlet, so a member is recognised at each branch.

**Is this only for restaurants?**
No. Zloya is built for restaurants, cafés, salons and stores, and memberships work the same way at each counter.

### Smart QR codes for guest data

URL: https://www.zutok.in/solutions/restaurant-qr-code-customer-data/

Product: Zutok Zloya

Zutok Zloya gives you smart QR codes for table standees, Swiggy and Zomato delivery boxes and partner stores. Guests scan, share their phone number and get a perk you choose, and each code shows its own scans, sign-ups and opt-in rate. Zloya is included free with ZChat Growth (₹5,000/month, or ₹3,999/month billed yearly) and Scale (₹10,000/month, or ₹7,499/month billed yearly), excl. 18% GST.

Smart QR codes are part of [Zutok Zloya](https://www.zutok.in/products/zloya/), which isn't sold on its own: it's included free with ZChat Growth (₹5,000/month, or ₹3,999/month billed yearly) and Scale (₹10,000/month, or ₹7,499/month billed yearly), excl. 18% GST.

#### FAQ

**Where can I put the QR codes?**
On table standees, on Swiggy and Zomato delivery boxes and at partner stores. Each placement gets its own code.

**What should I offer in exchange for a phone number?**
Something worth it where the code sits. For example, 50 bonus points on a table standee, or a dine-in offer like flat ₹150 off on a delivery box.

**Can I see who scanned a code?**
Scans are counted for each code. A guest joins your list when they share their phone number to claim the perk, so you see who signed up, not everyone who scanned.

**Can someone reuse the coupon?**
No. Every Zloya coupon is locked to one phone number, and redeeming it needs a one-time password sent to the guest's phone.

**What happens after a guest signs up?**
They appear in Zloya's smart segments, starting with New, which update automatically. Journeys like the first-visit welcome and the 30-day win-back then run on their own.

**Do I need a POS system?**
No. Zloya's POS quick counter runs in any browser. The cashier enters the bill amount and Zloya handles the rest.

### Birthday, win-back & expiry journeys

URL: https://www.zutok.in/solutions/automated-winback-birthday-campaigns/

Product: Zutok Zloya

Zutok Zloya runs five automated retention journeys: a first-visit welcome, a birthday greeting, a 30-day “we miss you” win-back, a points-expiry alert and post-visit feedback. Offers are locked to each guest's phone, and guests are sorted automatically into segments like Slipping (30 days) and Lost (60+ days). Zloya is included free with ZChat Growth (₹5,000/month, or ₹3,999/month billed yearly) and Scale (₹10,000/month, or ₹7,499/month billed yearly), excl. 18% GST.

#### FAQ

**Do I need to tag customers manually?**
No. Zloya keeps its six segments, from New to Lost, up to date on its own.

**Can anniversaries get the same offer as birthdays?**
Yes. Anniversaries work the same way as birthdays: a personal greeting with a gift and double points.

**What welcome offer should a new customer get?**
One that brings them back for a second visit soon. The example first-visit welcome is 15% off, valid for 14 days, and like every Zloya coupon it's locked to the guest's phone number.

**Can loyalty coupons be shared or misused?**
No. Every coupon is locked to one phone number, and every redemption needs a one-time password sent to the guest's phone.

**Does it work across several outlets?**
Yes. The same guest profile is shared across every outlet.

**How do I know if the journeys are working?**
Zloya's retention analytics show your repeat guest rate, loyalty-tracked sales and prepaid membership revenue on one dashboard.

## Industries

URL: https://www.zutok.in/industries/

Zutok Softwares makes Zutok CRM and three products that plug into it: ZChat for WhatsApp and Instagram chats, ZShop for store orders and Zloya for loyalty. Each guide below shows which of them fit one kind of business, how a typical day runs with them and what they cost in rupees.

### A CRM for Indian restaurants and cafés

URL: https://www.zutok.in/industries/restaurants-cafes/

Products used: Zutok Zloya, Zutok ZChat

Zutok helps restaurants and cafés in India bring guests back. Zutok Zloya awards loyalty points at the billing counter from any browser, collects guests' phone numbers through QR codes on tables and Swiggy or Zomato boxes, and runs birthday and win-back journeys. Zutok ZChat brings WhatsApp and Instagram enquiries into one inbox. Zloya comes free with ZChat Growth (₹5,000/month) and Scale (₹10,000/month), billed monthly, excluding 18% GST.

Zloya isn't sold on its own. It comes free with ZChat Growth at ₹5,000/month, which also gives you 1,500 contacts, 2 channels and 2 CRM licenses, and with ZChat Scale at ₹10,000/month, which has unlimited contacts, 4 channels and 4 CRM licenses. ZChat Starter, at ₹2,000/month for 500 contacts, 1 channel and 1 CRM license, covers enquiries but doesn't include Zloya. Prices are billed monthly and exclude 18% GST.

#### FAQ

**What is a restaurant CRM, and how is it different from a loyalty program?**
A restaurant CRM is the record of your guests: who they are, how often they visit and what they've earned. A loyalty program is one way to use it. In Zutok, Zloya is the loyalty layer, and guests from Zloya and chats from ZChat both land in Zutok CRM. Each guest record holds a phone number, visits and a points balance, and the same profile is shared across your outlets.

**How does a restaurant loyalty program work at the billing counter?**
The cashier opens Zloya's POS quick counter in a browser, looks the guest up by mobile number and enters the bill amount. Points are added automatically, at a higher rate for higher tiers. When a guest redeems, a one-time password sent to their phone confirms it.

**Do I need a POS integration to run loyalty in my restaurant?**
No. The POS quick counter runs in any browser, so the cashier enters the bill amount and Zloya handles the rest. If you run a chain and want your POS connected, ask about API / POS integration during your demo.

**How can my café collect customers' phone numbers?**
Put Zloya smart QR codes on table standees, delivery boxes and partner stores. Guests scan, share their number and get a perk. Each code shows its scans, sign-ups and opt-in rate, so you can see which placement works best.

**How does guest feedback work after a visit?**
The post-visit feedback journey sends guests a short rating link that takes about 30 seconds. They rate food, service, ambience and cleanliness, and low ratings alert a manager, who can follow up with that guest.

**How do I get more repeat customers at my restaurant?**
Notice who is drifting and give them a reason to return. Zloya moves guests into a Slipping segment after 30 days without a visit and a Lost segment after 60. The 30-day win-back journey sends them a coupon locked to their phone number, birthdays get a greeting with a gift and double points, and points-expiry reminders give regulars another reason to come in. These journeys are part of Zloya, which comes free with ZChat Growth and Scale.

**Can I run one loyalty program across several outlets?**
Yes. The same guest profile is shared across every outlet, so a regular is recognised at each branch.

### WhatsApp automation for D2C and fashion brands

URL: https://www.zutok.in/industries/d2c-fashion-brands/

Products used: Zutok ZShop, Zutok ZChat

Zutok gives Indian D2C and fashion brands one system for the whole sale. Zutok ZChat answers price and availability questions on WhatsApp and Instagram with an AI agent that quotes from your catalogue, and Zutok ZShop confirms COD orders, recovers abandoned carts and sends order updates for Shopify, WooCommerce or in-house stores. ZShop comes free with ZChat Growth (₹5,000/month) and Scale (₹10,000/month), billed monthly, excluding 18% GST.

ZShop sends its WhatsApp messages through ZChat, and it isn't sold on its own: it comes free with ZChat Growth at ₹5,000/month (1,500 contacts, 2 channels and 2 CRM licenses) and ZChat Scale at ₹10,000/month (unlimited contacts, 4 channels and 4 CRM licenses). So one plan covers both the chats and the store automation. Prices are billed monthly and exclude 18% GST.

#### FAQ

**How can a D2C brand automate WhatsApp order updates and COD confirmation?**
Connect your store to Zutok ZShop and map your Meta templates once. ZShop then sends placed, packed, shipped and delivered updates from your ZChat number, asks COD buyers to confirm, reminds them automatically and tags confirmed orders.

**Can an AI agent answer “is it in stock?” and price questions on WhatsApp and Instagram?**
Yes, from the catalogue you give it, on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and Telegram. ZChat's AI only offers options that exist in your rows and quotes the price and order link from the row that matches. Add availability as an information column and it answers that too. Nothing is guessed.

**How do fashion brands turn Instagram comments into sales chats?**
With ZChat's comment → DM automation. Set a rule on keywords like “price” or on any comment, and ZChat replies publicly and sends a private DM with the details. The conversation then continues in the shared inbox.

**What happens if an item sells out?**
Update the catalogue. ZChat's AI answers only from the rows and information columns you fill in, so change the availability column or the row, or re-import the sheet, and it answers from that. It doesn't sync live stock from your store.

**Does it work with both Shopify and WooCommerce stores?**
Yes. Shopify connects through a custom app with 32 webhook topics synced, WooCommerce or any platform with an API connects too, and an in-house shop works with items kept in the CRM. Every feature works the same on all three.

**Where do my Shopify and WooCommerce orders and buyers end up?**
In Zutok CRM. ZShop brings every order in, and every buyer becomes a CRM lead, matched on phone number only, and is saved to the CRM on delivery. Chats from ZChat become leads too, with their source, and you can import customers and leads from Excel or CSV and export them to CSV.

**How does Zutok avoid duplicate or mixed-up customers?**
ZShop matches every buyer to a CRM lead on phone number only, never on name, so two shoppers with the same name are never mixed up.

**Which plan suits a high-volume D2C brand?**
ZChat Scale, at ₹10,000/month excluding GST. It has unlimited contacts, 4 channels and 4 CRM licenses, with ZShop and Zloya included free.

### Real estate CRM for Indian brokers and property managers

URL: https://www.zutok.in/industries/real-estate/

Products used: Zutok CRM, Zutok ZChat

Zutok CRM is a real estate CRM for Indian brokers, agents and property managers. Its Real Estate suite keeps properties, owners, agents, brokers, buy and rent requests and tenants in one place, while leads from Meta Lead Ads and Zutok ZChat's WhatsApp inbox enter one pipeline. The suite is part of Zutok CRM, at ₹1,299 per user per month billed monthly, excluding 18% GST.

The Real Estate suite is part of Zutok CRM, which is priced per user: ₹1,299 per user per month, ₹1,199 per user with 3 users and ₹999 per user with 5 or more users; billed yearly it's 20% less (₹1,039, ₹959 and ₹799 per user per month), excluding 18% GST. For WhatsApp and Instagram enquiries, add a ZChat plan sized by the contacts and channels you need: Starter (₹2,000/month) includes 500 contacts, 1 channel and 1 CRM license, and Growth (₹5,000/month) 1,500 contacts, 2 channels and 2 CRM licenses.

#### FAQ

**What is a real estate CRM, and how is it different from a generic CRM?**
A real estate CRM adds the records property work needs on top of an ordinary lead pipeline. Zutok CRM's Real Estate suite adds properties and approvals, owners, agents, brokers, buy and rent requests, tenants and real estate reports, while leads still move from Enquiry to Follow-up, Hot and Customer.

**Can property enquiries from Meta ads and WhatsApp go into one CRM?**
Yes. Meta Lead Ads leads sync into Zutok CRM, and with ZChat every new WhatsApp or Instagram chat creates a lead with its source. Both enter the same Enquiry → Follow-up → Hot → Customer pipeline.

**How do brokers track what buyers and renters are looking for?**
Save each requirement as a buy or rent request in the Real Estate suite, next to the properties, owners and brokers you work with. Zutok CRM also lets you add custom fields for the details your requests need.

**Can Zutok remind me before a rental agreement is due for renewal?**
Yes. When a rental closes, add the tenant in the Real Estate suite and keep their contract on file, and the contract reminds you before it's due for renewal. That helps with the 11-month agreements common in Indian rentals.

**Is it a tenant or PG management app?**
No. Zutok keeps tenants and their contracts as records next to your leads and properties, but it isn't built for rent collection, tenant KYC, maintenance requests or a tenant portal.

**Which lead sources does it support?**
Meta Lead Ads, IndiaMART, website estimate requests, chats from ZChat and imports from Excel or CSV. It has no 99acres, MagicBricks or Housing.com integration.

**Can the WhatsApp AI send a property brochure to an enquirer?**
Yes. In ZChat, add a file column to your catalogue and attach the brochure, price list, PDF or video to the right row. When the AI quotes from that row, the customer gets the real file. The AI agent is part of Zutok ZChat, with plans from ₹2,000/month.

**How much does a real estate CRM cost with Zutok?**
The Real Estate suite is part of Zutok CRM, priced per user (one CRM license is one user). Zutok CRM costs ₹1,299 per user per month, ₹1,199 per user with 3 users and ₹999 per user with 5 or more users; billed yearly it's 20% less (₹1,039, ₹959 and ₹799 per user per month), excluding 18% GST. ZChat is optional for WhatsApp and Instagram enquiries, and Meta's WhatsApp charges are billed separately.

### CRM for agencies and service businesses in India

URL: https://www.zutok.in/industries/agencies-services/

Products used: Zutok CRM, Zutok ZChat

Zutok CRM is a CRM for Indian agencies, consultancies and service firms that runs the whole client cycle: leads, proposals, projects with tasks and timesheets, GST invoices and payments, then support tickets. Zutok ZChat adds a shared WhatsApp and Instagram inbox for client conversations. Zutok CRM costs ₹1,299 per user per month billed monthly (₹999 per user with 5 or more users), excluding 18% GST.

Zutok CRM is priced per user, so the cost follows your team size: ₹1,299 per user per month, ₹1,199 per user with 3 users and ₹999 per user with 5 or more users; billed yearly it's 20% less (₹1,039, ₹959 and ₹799 per user per month), excluding 18% GST. No module depends on the number of users: proposals, estimates, GST invoices, projects and timesheets, contracts, expenses, subscriptions, HRM and reports are all part of Zutok CRM.

#### FAQ

**What CRM features does a digital agency need?**
At the least: a lead pipeline, proposals, projects with tasks and timesheets, GST invoicing with payment tracking, and a client profile that ties them together. Zutok CRM has all of these, plus contracts, support tickets and reports on sales, leads and timesheets.

**Can I go from proposal to GST invoice to payment in one tool?**
Yes. Send a proposal or estimate in Zutok CRM, turn it into a GST invoice once it is accepted and record the payment. Recurring invoices and credit notes are built in, and you can export invoices in bulk as PDF.

**Can I track project timesheets for each client?**
Yes. Projects hold milestones, tasks, timesheets and meeting notes, and each project is linked to the customer it belongs to. Reports, including timesheet reports, are part of Zutok CRM too.

**Is a CRM project module different from a separate project tool?**
Yes, mostly in where it lives. In Zutok CRM, projects sit on the same customer profile as proposals, GST invoices, payments, tickets and contracts, with milestones, tasks, timesheets and meeting notes, so there's no second tool to keep in sync. It covers those essentials rather than everything a specialist project tool does.

**Are project timesheets the same as staff attendance?**
No. Project timesheets log hours against client projects, and timesheet reports show where the time went. Attendance and leave are separate HR modules in Zutok CRM.

**What happens after a project launches?**
Follow-up requests come in as support tickets on the client's profile, and the client's contract reminds you before it's due for renewal.

**Can each client's WhatsApp chats sit next to their projects and invoices?**
They live in the same Zutok account. ZChat keeps client chats in a shared inbox and creates a CRM lead for every new chat, with its source. The client's invoices, projects and tickets sit on their customer profile in Zutok CRM.

**What does Zutok CRM cost for a large agency team?**
With 5 or more users, Zutok CRM costs ₹999 per user per month billed monthly, or ₹799 per user per month billed yearly (₹9,588 per user per year), excluding 18% GST. Every module is part of Zutok CRM whatever the number of users, and each staff member gets a role with its own permissions.

### WhatsApp automation for clinics, labs and salons

URL: https://www.zutok.in/industries/clinics-labs-salons/

Zutok helps clinics, diagnostic labs and salons in India handle WhatsApp enquiries. Zutok ZChat puts appointment and price chats in one shared inbox, and its AI agent quotes test or service prices only from the price list you add. Salons can add Zutok Zloya for memberships, prepaid wallets and repeat-visit reminders. ZChat starts at ₹2,000/month, and Zloya comes free with ZChat Growth (₹5,000/month) and Scale (₹10,000/month), billed monthly, excluding 18% GST.

The shared inbox and the AI agent that quotes your price list are part of Zutok ZChat. ZChat Starter costs ₹2,000/month for 500 contacts, 1 channel and 1 CRM license. Salons that want Zloya's memberships, prepaid wallets and win-back journeys can choose ZChat Growth (₹5,000/month) or Scale (₹10,000/month), which include Zloya free. Prices are billed monthly and exclude 18% GST.

#### FAQ

**Can a WhatsApp AI agent quote my lab test or salon service prices accurately?**
Yes, as long as the prices are in your catalogue. ZChat's AI asks the customer each choice and quotes only from the row that matches all of them, so it never makes up a price. It can also send your full price list as a PDF.

**How can a clinic or salon handle appointment enquiries on WhatsApp?**
Bring them into ZChat's shared inbox, where staff see All, Mine and Unassigned chats and mark each one Open, Pending or Resolved. The AI can answer timings and location, then hand the chat to staff to confirm the slot.

**Can a salon sell memberships and prepaid packages?**
Yes, with Zutok Zloya. Sell yearly perk bundles or prepaid wallets at the counter, like pay ₹5,000 and get ₹6,000 in credit, and track staff sales on a leaderboard. Zloya comes free with ZChat Growth and Scale.

**Is the WhatsApp Business app enough for a clinic's front desk?**
For a busy desk, ZChat runs on the official WhatsApp Business Platform instead, with a shared inbox for your team, the AI agent and Meta-approved templates. Free-form replies are allowed within 24 hours of the patient's last message, and later messages go out as approved templates. Zutok helps you set up and verify the number.

**What happens when a patient asks a medical question?**
The AI answers only from the facts you give it, so keep those to prices, timings, directions and similar business details. A clinical question falls outside its instructions and goes to your staff through handoff, with the whole chat history, and staff also confirm appointment slots.

**How do I win back salon clients who stopped coming?**
Zloya flags clients who haven't visited for 30 days as Slipping, and the 30-day win-back journey sends them a coupon locked to their phone number. Birthday messages add another reason to return. Zloya comes free with ZChat Growth and Scale.

**How can a salon track prepaid credits and membership revenue?**
Zloya's retention dashboard shows prepaid membership revenue next to your repeat guest rate and loyalty-tracked sales, and the staff leaderboard shows how many memberships each person has sold.

### CRM for retail stores, chains and franchises

URL: https://www.zutok.in/industries/retail-franchises/

Products used: Zutok CRM, Zutok Zloya, Zutok ZShop

Zutok is a CRM for Indian retail stores, chains and franchises. Zutok CRM tracks stock across warehouses and staff attendance and leave; Zutok Zloya runs one loyalty program across every outlet with a shared customer profile; and Zutok ZShop sends WhatsApp updates for counter orders. Zutok CRM, with inventory and HRM included, costs ₹1,299 per user per month billed monthly, excluding 18% GST.

Inventory, HRM, payroll, attendance and leave are part of Zutok CRM, priced per user: ₹1,299 per user per month, ₹1,199 per user with 3 users and ₹999 per user with 5 or more users; billed yearly it's 20% less (₹1,039, ₹959 and ₹799 per user per month), excluding 18% GST. For loyalty and counter-order updates, Zloya and ZShop come free with ZChat Growth (₹5,000/month) and Scale (₹10,000/month). Chains with 10 or more outlets can ask for special pricing during the demo.

#### FAQ

**How can a retail chain run one loyalty program across all its outlets?**
Use Zutok Zloya, which comes free with ZChat Growth and Scale. Every outlet uses the POS quick counter, and the same customer profile is shared across all of them, so a customer is recognised at every store.

**Can I manage stock across warehouses and staff attendance in the same CRM?**
Yes. Zutok CRM includes inventory and warehouse management, with a full history for every warehouse, alongside HRM, payroll, attendance and leave.

**Can I see stock for each warehouse separately?**
Yes. Zutok CRM keeps a full stock history for every warehouse, with warehouse reports.

**How do I record damaged or lost stock?**
Record it as a loss or an adjustment in the same inventory module, so that warehouse's history stays accurate.

**I only sell at the counter. Can I still send WhatsApp order updates?**
Yes. Choose ZShop's in-house shop, keep your items in the CRM and take orders at the counter. Every automation still works. ZShop sends the WhatsApp messages through ZChat and comes free with ZChat Growth and Scale.

**What does it cost to send WhatsApp updates for counter orders?**
ZShop isn't sold on its own: it's included free with ZChat Growth (₹5,000/month, or ₹3,999/month billed yearly) and Scale (₹10,000/month, or ₹7,499/month billed yearly). Meta's charges are billed separately, and prices exclude 18% GST.

**Is there special pricing for franchises with many outlets?**
Yes. Zutok has special pricing for chains with 10 or more outlets; ask about it during your demo.

**Does Zutok replace my billing or POS software?**
No. Zloya's POS quick counter runs in any browser next to your current billing, so you don't need an integration to start. If you want your POS connected, ask about API / POS integration during your demo.
